newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha market quiet, overhang continues.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha market quiet, overhang continues.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets saw a very slow day on Monday with many traders away on holiday.
Levels moved down in line with the rest of the product market -- losing around $2-4 a tonne on the day.
Supply was heard ample for the limited prompt demand and some expected levels to lose more ground over the coming days.
"There's more around than is needed. I think people are tanking it if they can," one trader said.
End-user petrochemical demand was light with most said covered until mid-January.
Late talk put January swaps around $214//215 for Feb with March offered at $212 a tonne.
